thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — billing-metering.token-drift detected. Alert: token-count delta > 10% between emitter and ledger for customer-facing window 2026-03-17T02:00-02:30Z. Link: https://ops/redwood/incidents/1718201234 :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): paging in. I’m on call for billing. Initial check: are customers seeing overage emails? :thinking_face:

lisa (support): FYI: support queue 42 shows ~6 customers flagged for sudden overage emails in the last 10m. Tickets incoming.

jordan (billing): Confirmed — our webhook shows ~12 overage flags emitted between 02:07 and 02:12Z. Most are small accounts. Not sure if counts are inflated or if ingestion delayed earlier.

maria (infra): Reproduction logs: emitter-service shows a flush backlog around 02:03Z due to transient SQS throttling. I see duplicate ack receipts at 02:04-02:06Z.

samir (eng-runtime): Adding context — runtime KV cache TTL churn combined with emitter batch retry could produce duplicate token emits if dedupe token missing. Investigating feature flag ff/emitter-dedupe.

ops-bot: Deploy: emitter-service v2.9.3 rolled at 2026-03-16T23:00Z. No automated rollback. Recent config change: sqs_max_inflight from 100 -> 400 on 2026-03-16T23:15Z.

alex (oncall): OK. Priority: 1) prevent new incorrect counts, 2) assess customer impact, 3) start reconciliation plan. Proposed immediate actions?

maria (infra): Action 1: Temporarily pause propagation from emitter -> billing-queue (pause via feature flag) to stop new emits reaching billing. I can flip ff/emitter-propagation.pause now. This will not drop messages, they'll remain in emitter backlog.

samir (eng-runtime): Action 2: Enable strict dedupe path on emitter (ff/emitter-dedupe.force=true) and increase de-dup window to 5m. That should avoid duplicate counts during backlog flush. Will push a config patch to config-service now.

jordan (billing): Action 3: Hold automated overage notification job for billing-window 02:00-02:30Z to prevent more customer alerts. I'll pause send-job for that window and mark flags as pending.

kayla (cust-success): If we pause notifications, CS needs a customer advisory drafted. I can prepare a short status note and send to impacted accounts once we have confirmed root cause and remediation ETA.

lisa (support): I’ll add templates for proactive credits if we determine overcharges. Need approval from finance for credits > $500.

maria (infra): Done: ff/emitter-propagation.pause = true (02:04:12Z). Propagation halted. Confirming no new messages forwarded.

ops-bot: Event: ff/emitter-propagation.pause toggled by maria at 02:04:13Z.

samir (eng-runtime): Pushed ff/emitter-dedupe.force=true and dedupe_window=300s at 02:06:05Z. Emission pipeline now de-duplicating with stricter keys.

alex (oncall): Good. Jordan, hold on notifications. Kayla, prep advisory. Maria/samir, can you run a quick diff between emitter-aggregate and billing-ledger for that half-hour? We need magnitude and list of affected customers.

jordan (billing): Running ledger diff script: /ops/tools/ledger_diff --start 2026-03-17T02:00Z --end 2026-03-17T02:30Z --out /tmp/diff-1718201234.csv

jordan (billing): Results preview: 1) 278 accounts with >1% delta. 2) 48 accounts with >10% delta. 3) top skew shows duplication pattern (counts are multiples of expected, commonly x2). Exporting full list now.

maria (infra): Stack traces show emitter retried a batch with identical batch_id due to transient SQS visibility timeout. Dedup metadata was expired because earlier config reduced dedupe_window to 60s (prod change on 2026-03-16T23:14Z). That lines up with the duplicated multiples.

samir (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: config rollback on 2026-03-16 inadvertently set dedupe_window too low and sqs_max_inflight increase caused reordering and retries — duplicate emits landed in billing without dedupe.

alex (oncall): Impact assessment? jordan/kayla please summarize: how many customers saw overage flags and how many will actually be billed extra if ledger left as-is?

jordan (billing): From diff: estimated extra token count ~ +14.6% overall for affected window. If billed, ~32 customers would see non-trivial $ impact (> $50), and ~6 > $500. But some of those are artifacts (duplicates) not real usage.

kayla (cust-success): Draft advisory: "We observed a metering anomaly that caused duplicate usage flags for a subset of customers between 02:00-02:30Z. We are pausing billing notifications and performing a manual reconciliation. No charges will be finalized while we investigate." Sending draft to alex for signoff.

alex (oncall): Approve. Kayla send to support and queued customers list after Jordan confirms.

lisa (support): Opening a pinned triage doc: https://docs.redwood/triage/1718201234 with runbook steps: pause propagation, pause notifications, reconcile ledger, issue credits as needed.

samir (eng-runtime): Running reconciliation plan: 1) mark suspect emits with tag suspect_dup=true; 2) re-run aggregator to collapse duplicate batch_ids using earliest timestamp; 3) produce reconciled ledger export. Starting step 1 now.

ops-bot: Job started: reconciliation-run-1718201234 by samir at 02:12:41Z.

maria (infra): Note: backlog size ~1.2M tokens for window. Reprocessing estimated 18m. We should do a dry-run first and validate counts on a sample subset (top 200 accounts).

jordan (billing): Dry-run done on sample: duplicates collapsed, discrepancies drop to <0.3% for sample. Looks promising.

alex (oncall): If dry-run validates, we proceed with full reprocess, then unpause propagation and release corrected counts to billing. Meanwhile keep notifications paused and send interim advisory. Also prep a customer credit plan for the 6 accounts > $500.

kayla (cust-success): Interim advisory posted to status.redwood.com and CS channels. I’m notifying top impacted accounts directly with the draft.

lisa (support): Tickets merged into incident epic. Triagers assigned.

maria (infra): Reprocess kicked off at 02:20:03Z. Monitor at /ops/metrics/emitter/reprocess/1718201234.

samir (eng-runtime): Reprocess progress: 25% complete at 02:30Z. Estimated finish 02:38Z. No new duplicate emits observed after dedupe toggle.

jordan (billing): After reprocess completion, ledger export shows reconciled delta median <0.2%. I’m preparing reconciled flags for billing-run.

ops-bot: Job complete: reconciliation-run-1718201234 completed at 02:37:54Z.

alex (oncall): Great work. Next steps: 1) unpause propagation (so future emits flow normally) but keep notification sends paused until billing-run confirmed. 2) run a targeted billing-run using reconciled ledger for the affected window. 3) issue credits where applicable and close incident with postmortem.

maria (infra): ff/emitter-propagation.pause = false (02:38:10Z). Unpaused.

jordan (billing): Billing-run with reconciled data scheduled for 02:45Z. If final numbers match dry-run within tolerance, we'll resume notifications and mark incident resolved.

kayla (cust-success): CS will send final note after billing-run. Prepared credit approvals for the 6 > $500.

lisa (support): All active tickets updated. No customers reported actual incorrect charge yet (only emails).

samir (eng-runtime): Long-term action items: 1) make dedupe_window an enforced invariant for emitter; 2) add alert when dedupe_window < 5m in prod; 3) improve SQS visibility/auto-backoff docs. I'll create GH issues.

alex (oncall): Thanks team. I'm switching to post-incident channel once billing-run is done. Please escalate if ledger diff > 0.5% after final run.

kayla (cust-success): Final: billing-run completed, reconciled counts accepted. Notifications released at 02:51Z. No incorrect charges issued. Draft postmortem in progress.

alex (oncall): Closing pager. Incident severity: P2 (customer-visible emails, no billing impact). Postmortem owners: samir, maria, jordan.

incident-bot: Incident 1718201234 closed by alex (oncall) at 02:52:10Z. Labels: billing, metering, reprocessing, customer-impact-minor.
